item.name: Chopping
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9 add chopping speed. Level 3 unlocks Butcher Access, level 5 unlocks Burger Stand Access, and level 10 gives the Chopping Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Butcher Access, Burger Stand Access, chopping speed boosts.
item.recommendedFoods: Source table highlights Guacamole and Irish Stew as 100% chopping-step foods, with Coleslaw, Papaya Salad, and Salmon Soup also listed near the top.
item.cardSummary: Chopping is the cooking milestone for repeated chopping steps. Push it when you want stand access and faster chopping from normal dish prep.

item.name: Baking
item.maxProgress: About 667 bakes to reach max level.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9 add mixing speed. Level 3 unlocks Bakery Access, level 5 unlocks Cake Stand Access, and level 10 gives the Baking Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Bakery Access, Cake Stand Access, mixing speed boosts.
item.recommendedFoods: Source table examples include Mac and Cheese, Sweet Potato Pie, Nachos, Profiteroles, and Creme Caramel as foods with one listed baking-related step out of two.
item.cardSummary: Baking levels through bake steps and pays off with bakery-style access plus mixing speed rewards.

item.name: Frying
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9 add frying speed. Level 3 unlocks Fishmonger Access, level 5 unlocks Sushi Stand Access, and level 10 gives the Frying Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Fishmonger Access, Sushi Stand Access, frying speed boosts.
item.recommendedFoods: Source table highlights Steak Frites as a 100% frying-step food, with Chow Mein, Kung Pao Chicken, Soto, and Pad Thai also listed near the top.
item.cardSummary: Frying is slower per action than chopping or baking in the source rates, so food choice matters when pushing its speed and stand unlocks.

item.name: Serving
item.xpSources: Take orders, serve dishes, and collect dishes.
item.xpRate: 10 XP per order; 20 XP per served or collected dish
item.maxProgress: Capped source pools: 2,500 orders, 1,250 served dishes, and 1,250 collected dishes for max XP.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 increase tip chance. Level 5 gives 10 Diamonds, level 9 lists Ice Cream Stand Access as coming soon, and level 10 gives the Serving Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Tip chance boosts, 10 Diamonds, Ice Cream Stand Access.
item.comingSoonRewards: Ice Cream Stand Access is marked coming soon.
item.cardSummary: Serving rewards front-of-house work: orders, delivered dishes, and cleared dishes. It is the milestone to push when service flow is your main grind.

item.name: Food Mastery
item.xpSources: Buy organic ingredients, buy advanced kitchen items, and unlock food.
item.xpRate: 100 XP per ingredient purchase; 100 XP per advanced kitchen item; food unlock XP uses Food Level x 5
item.maxProgress: Ingredient and advanced kitchen item sources each cap at 5,000 XP. Food unlocks cap at 45,000 XP, but the source says food levels are unknown.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, and 8 increase Food Critic chance. Level 6 unlocks Pizza Stand Access, level 9 gives 15 Diamonds, and level 10 gives the Food Mastery Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Food Critic chance boosts, Pizza Stand Access, 15 Diamonds.
item.cardSummary: Food Mastery is the menu and ingredient milestone. It is best tracked around ingredient purchases, advanced kitchen items, and food unlock progress.

item.name: Building
item.xpSources: Buy items from the Build Menu.
item.maxProgress: Category caps vary: walls and roofs cap at 7,000 XP each, art caps at 4,000 XP, several utility categories cap at 3,000 XP, and many furniture/build categories cap at 5,000 XP.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 increase Celebrity chance. Level 5 gives the Sakura Hut starter restaurant, level 9 gives the Tatami Restaurant starter restaurant, and level 10 gives the Building Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Celebrity chance boosts, Sakura Hut starter restaurant, Tatami Restaurant starter restaurant.
item.cardSummary: Building is the milestone for decorating and expanding through Build Mode purchases. Its standout rewards are celebrity chance and exclusive starter restaurants.

item.name: Leadership
item.xpSources: Customize workers, create worker outfits, upgrade workers, and hire workers.
item.xpRate: 100 XP per customization or outfit; upgrade XP equals upgrade price up to 1,000 XP; hire XP equals worker price up to 2,000 XP
item.maxProgress: Customization and outfit sources each cap at 2,000 XP. Worker upgrades cap at 30,000 XP and worker hiring caps at 20,000 XP.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 increase tip amounts. Levels 5 and 9 give Diamonds, and level 10 gives the Leadership Trophy.
item.cardSummary: Leadership is the worker milestone. It grows through hiring, upgrading, outfits, and customization rather than through direct cooking or building alone.

item.name: Management
item.xpSources: Reach restaurant stars and buy upgrades.
item.xpRate: 5,000 XP per star; upgrade XP equals half the upgrade price up to 2,500 XP
item.maxProgress: Star progress caps at 25,000 XP and upgrade purchases cap at 30,000 XP.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 increase VIP chance. Level 5 unlocks Supermarket Access, level 9 lists Sandwich Stand Access as coming soon, and level 10 gives the Management Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: VIP chance boosts, Supermarket Access, Sandwich Stand Access.
item.comingSoonRewards: Sandwich Stand Access is marked coming soon.
item.cardSummary: Management rewards overall restaurant progress through stars and upgrade purchases. Track it when you are buying upgrades or pushing star milestones.

item.name: Gardening
item.xpSources: Buy nature items, buy outdoor items, and harvest crops.
item.xpRate: 100 XP per nature or outdoor item; crop harvest XP equals Grow Time x 4 up to 2,000 XP
item.maxProgress: Nature items cap at 15,000 XP, outdoor items cap at 10,000 XP, and crop harvests cap at 35,000 XP.
item.levelRewards: Levels 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 add farm slots. Level 5 unlocks Farm Access, level 9 lists Smoothie Stand Access as coming soon, and level 10 gives the Gardening Trophy.
item.notableUnlocks: Farm slots, Farm Access, Smoothie Stand Access.
item.comingSoonRewards: Smoothie Stand Access is marked coming soon.
item.cardSummary: Gardening mixes build-mode nature purchases with crop harvesting. It is the milestone to follow when farm slots and farming unlocks matter.
